[[Hedge Wizard Mabai]] is a gardener in the [[Garden of Seborhin]], but can later be found in the [[Halls of Chokhin]] once the quest [[Puzzling Parchment]] is completed. ==Locations== *[[Vabbi]] **{{NPC location|Forum Highlands}} (only during [[One Man's Dream]]) **{{NPC location|Garden of Seborhin}} **{{NPC location|Holdings of Chokhin}} (only during One Man's Dream) ==Quests== '''Quests given:''' *[[Garden Chores]] *[[One Man's Dream]] '''Quests involved in:''' *[[Puzzling Parchment]] ==Dialogue== In the Garden of Seborhin: :''Sweet [[Princess Leifah]]...if only I'd have been born into royalty. Alas, my tattered rags are all you'll ever see of me. If wealth is what I need to gain your eye, then wealth is what I shall amass.'' In Holdings of Chokhin: :''"He who thinks money buys happiness is sorely misinformed. No amount of riches can purchase the love of the fair [[Princess Leifah]]. The gift of her heart is only acquired with the honesty of devotion."'' ==Trivia== * Mabai [[One Man's Dream|uses an urn]] to summon a wish-giving Djinn, a story similar to [[w:Aladdin|Aladdin's lamp]].
